reason: Both satisfy all hard requirements equally well, but Response B shows sharper operational awareness of this exact scenario—explicitly addressing that a snapshot mechanism can itself be degraded when disk is already near-full, and providing a second, more discriminating abort/rollback condition that catches false-diagnosis risk (reconsidering root cause if latency doesn't improve after disk mitigation) rather than only covering the disk-growth case. It also offers a more targeted low-risk mitigation (killing the specific runaway query) before escalating to failover.
